verdict.rationale: Apple's own launch material claims M4 Max "delivers exceptional battery life in a laptop," which touches the core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows fanless or thin, quiet designs, gives battery-life figures, or independently corroborates the claim; the cited power-efficiency evidence is a single vendor sentence. Missing for 10: fanless/low-power design evidence, quiet/thermal evidence, quantified battery-life figures, independent battery testing.

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence

citations.quote: thanks to the energy efficiency of Apple silicon, delivers exceptional battery life in a laptop
